Marcus Johnson

PhD Candidate

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Marcus is investigating tumor heterogeneity and clonal evolution using single-cell sequencing technologies. His work aims to understand how different cancer cell populations compete and cooperate within tumors, with implications for predicting treatment outcomes.

Areas of expertise

Tumor Heterogeneity · Single-Cell Analysis · Cancer Genomics

Education as supplied

  • MS in Cancer Biology, MD Anderson Cancer Center
  • BS in Molecular Biology, Yale University

Research interests

  • Single-cell genomics
  • Tumor microenvironment evolution
  • Clonal competition dynamics
  • Predictive modeling of treatment response

Publication records as supplied

  • Johnson, M. & Rodriguez, M. (2023). Spatial patterns of clonal evolution in tumors. Cancer Cell.
  • Johnson, M. et al. (2022). Single-cell analysis reveals tumor ecosystem dynamics. Nature Communications.
